notes: Hospital is at 901 Harry S. Truman Drive North, Largo, MD 20774. You will get a confirmation email within two business days after sending the application and health form.
name: UM Capital Region Health Student and Teen Volunteers
org: University of Maryland Capital Region Health (Largo)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital in 4-hour shifts, working toward 100 hours within 12 months.
who_can_apply: Students 16 or older. You need to clear immunization checks and a background check. You also do online training. Bring an ID to the orientation interview.
duration: 100 hours within 12 months, 4 hours per shift
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The process usually takes about one month.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online volunteer application. Send back the onboarding form by fax or by email. Go to an orientation. You will have an interview with the volunteer coordinator. Then finish training and the background check. The email is UMCapitalRegionVolunteer@umm.edu.
